"This is a description of the chart titled **"Official Exchange Rate and REER (AR$/US$)."** 

### Chart Overview
The chart tracks two metrics over time from August 5th to May 31st:
1.  **Official ER (Official Exchange Rate):** Represented by a dark blue line, measured against the left Y-axis (AR$/US$).
2.  **REER (Real Effective Exchange Rate):** Represented by a light blue line, measured against the right-hand side (rhs) Y-axis. The legend notes that an increase in value (+) represents depreciation.

### Axes Scales
*   **X-Axis (Time):** Dates ranging from 5-Aug to 31-May in approximately bi-weekly increments.
*   **Left Y-Axis (AR$/US$):** Units from 200 to 1000 in increments of 100.
*   **Right Y-Axis (REER):** Units from 50 to 190 in increments of 20.

### Data Trends and Key Figures
The following table summarizes the significant shifts and approximate values observed in the chart:

| Date Period | Official ER (Dark Blue Line - Left Axis) | REER (Light Blue Line - Right Axis) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **5-Aug** | Starts just below 300. | Starts near 100. |
| **Mid-August** | Jumps to 350. | Jumps to approx. 115-120. |
| **Mid-Aug to Dec 17** | Remains flat at 350. | Trends steadily downward (appreciates) to approx. 75-80. |
| **18-Dec (Major Shift)** | Jumps sharply to **800**. | Spikes sharply to approx. **170** (depreciation). |
| **Jan to May 31** | Trends upward (crawling peg), ending near **900**. | Trends steadily downward (appreciates), ending near **90**. |

### Summary of Content
The chart illustrates a significant devaluation event occurring on December 18th, where the official exchange rate was adjusted from 350 to 800 AR$/US$. Following this event, the official rate has undergone a steady, gradual increase, while the Real Effective Exchange Rate (REER) has shown a consistent trend of appreciation (declining values on the right axis) after the initial spike."
